ios.desc:
SpringHabt is the habit tracker built around how real life actually works.

Most habit apps make you commit to the same thing at the same time every day. Miss once and your streak is gone. SpringHabt is different — instead of locking you into a rigid schedule, it lets you commit to a goal and hit it however the day allows.

Work out 30 minutes a day — split across a morning walk and an evening session if you need to. Read 20 pages — ten before lunch, ten before bed. SpringHabt tracks what you actually accomplish, not whether you did it at exactly the right time.

Build the daily, weekly, and monthly routines that stick. See your progress in clean charts and streak views that show you exactly where you're winning and where you're slipping. Stay motivated, stay organized, and keep your goals where you can see them.

UNLIMITED HABITS Track every goal that matters to you. No arbitrary limits — just your full system, organized in one place.

CUSTOM QUIZZES Create quizzes tied directly to your habits to reinforce what you're learning and make retention part of the routine. Turn your habits into real knowledge.

FOCUS TIMERS Built-in timers that lock you in and help you actually complete the habits you've committed to. No context switching, no excuses.

DETAILED STATS AND CHARTS Track your consistency across days, weeks, and months. See the patterns, understand where you're slipping, and double down on what's working.

Whether you're building your first daily routine or dialing in a system you've been refining for years, SpringHabt gives you the flexibility to show up on your own terms — and the tools to prove to yourself that you did.

Start your streak today.
